# assets/third_party

Only third-party assets whose license **explicitly allows** redistributing the original files go here. Use one folder per source; each folder must contain a `LICENSE` and a `SOURCE.md`.

See [`../README.md`](../README.md) for the classification rules, the `SOURCE.md` template and the list of sources confirmed safe to commit.

## Collected packs (2026-11-17)

Every art pack below is **CC0 1.0** (the font is OFL 1.1, listed separately) (public domain dedication). The license was checked on the source page on the download date, and each folder keeps the author's own license note where one was shipped. Credit is not required, but all of them are listed in [`../../CREDITS.md`](../../CREDITS.md).

They are reference material and placeholder art for pre-production: a style study for characters, horror atmosphere and map composition, and grey-boxing before original art replaces them. Mixing many packs in the final game will not give a consistent look (different palettes and pixel densities), so pick a small set per prototype.

- `preview.png` in each folder is a contact sheet generated from that pack's own files by [`tools/asset_previews.py`](../../tools/asset_previews.py). It is a derivative of CC0 files and carries no extra restrictions.
- Only graphics were kept. Audio, demo code, fonts and large PSD/vector sources were left out; each `SOURCE.md` says exactly what was dropped and why.
- How these packs relate to RPG Maker sprite and tile formats, and where to find horror references and non-redistributable sources, is in [`docs/design-references.md`](../../docs/design-references.md) (Korean).

### Checked and not committed

| Candidate | Reason |
|---|---|
| Pipoya free RPG character sprites / RPG tileset 32x32 (itch.io) | The itch.io pages say "Not redistribute or resell this assets." Usable in a game, but goes in `assets_private/` |
| Mage City Arcanos (Hyptosis, OpenGameArt, CC0) | The author describes it as "a total conversion on an rpgmakerxp tileset", so it may be derived from RPG Maker XP RTP graphics |
| 2d JRPG dot character (OpenGameArt) | Re-upload of a Japanese artist's material by a third party; the original site's terms are unknown |
| Misc household items (NaRNeRZz, OpenGameArt) | Part of it is based on another artist's line art whose license is not stated |
| Kenney packs from kenney.nl | The site refuses automated downloads from this environment. The two Kenney packs above were taken from Kenney's own OpenGameArt uploads instead |
